notes.title: Major Updates
notes.notes:
It's taken quite a while since the last update.

The changes in this update are

[b]1.Change the map design[/b]

[b]2.Change the design of the enemy character[/b]

[b]3. Change of stage clear condition[/b]

[u]In addition, the sale price of the game itself has been significantly reduced to make it more affordable.[/u]

We will continue to make changes as they become available, so please stay tuned.
